privileged_info_for_vlm: The task requires specific naming and values: Workspaces: 'infrastructure' (URI: http://infrastructure.authority.gov/gis) and 'environment' (URI: http://environment.authority.gov/gis). Stores: 'infra_data' and 'env_data' (Host: gs-postgis, Port: 5432, DB: gis). Layers: 'settlements' (from ne_populated_places) and 'waterways' (from ne_rivers). Styles: 'settlement_marker' must use orange #FFA500 and size 8; 'waterway_line' must use blue #0080FF and width 2. Layer Group: 'regional_portal' must contain both layers.
